description: This file defines an immutable Java class `ImmutableJsonArray` that models a JSON array, providing methods for creation, manipulation, serialization, and parsing of JSON arrays, with internal caching and optimized representations.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArray
classes.description: An immutable representation of a JSON array supporting creation, addition of elements, iteration, and serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArray.SoftReferencedValueList
classes.description: An internal class managing caching and representations of the JSON array’s internal list of values in JSON and CBOR formats.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArray.ValueListJsonHandler
classes.description: A handler for parsing JSON array strings into a list of JsonValues, supporting nested arrays and objects.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a singleton instance of an empty JSON array.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an `ImmutableJsonArray` from a list of `JsonValue` objects, possibly with provided string or CBOR representations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new `ImmutableJsonArray` with specified elements added, supporting various data types.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index as an `Optional<JsonValue>`.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the JSON array is empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the JSON array.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given `JsonValue` is present in the array.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a specified `JsonValue` in the array.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the array’s `JsonValue` elements.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of the `JsonValue` elements.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the JSON array using the provided `SerializationContext`.

methods.name: upperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Estimates the upper bound of the string size when serialized.
